nodes.text: 13C NMR shows 8 signals: aromatic carbons at 138.76, 131.45 (x2), 130.59 (x2), 121.30 ppm and aliphatic CH2 at 43.47 and 38.60 ppm
Mass spectrum shows m/z 198.99966 (100%) and 200.99765 (97.6%), an almost 1:1 M:M+2 pattern
Nearly 1:1 M:M+2 isotope pattern is characteristic of bromine (79Br:81Br ≈ 1:1), not chlorine

support.quote:

So the compound likely contains BROMINE, not chlorine!
